gaps.sentence: She ___ no difficulty finding the address.
gaps.hint: fixed pattern: ___ no difficulty doing something
gaps.explanation: have no difficulty (in) doing something is the fixed pattern; 'made no difficulty' is wrong.

gaps.sentence: He ___ a fortune selling software online.
gaps.explanation: make a fortune means to earn a very large amount of money.

gaps.sentence: The company ___ interest on the money it borrows.
gaps.explanation: pay interest is the standard financial collocation.

gaps.sentence: We were asked to ___ an experiment in the laboratory.
gaps.explanation: do an experiment is the standard collocation in scientific contexts.

gaps.sentence: He always ___ the truth, however unpleasant it is.
gaps.explanation: tell the truth is the fixed collocation; 'say the truth' is a common learner error.

gaps.sentence: He ___ some ridiculous excuse about his car breaking down.
gaps.explanation: make an excuse is the fixed collocation; 'tell an excuse' is not used.

gaps.sentence: Ordering your food online can ___ you a lot of time.
gaps.explanation: save somebody time means to make it possible for them to use less time.

gaps.sentence: We should ___ an effort to arrive on time.
gaps.explanation: make an effort is the fixed collocation meaning to try hard.
